chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q6 — Continuity and Change (5 points)
chunks.content: AP Art History Q6, Continuity and Change, 5 points (Tasks A–E, 1 point each, independent). A: accurately describe ONE visual characteristic of the shown work (this administration: the Ludovisi Battle Sarcophagus). B–E: use specific visual and/or contextual evidence to explain continuities and/or changes the work demonstrates relative to earlier or later traditions (e.g. how it continues or departs from prior conventions, and the significance of those continuities/changes). Describe = characteristics beyond naming; the explain tasks require evidence tied to continuity or change.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q6 exemplar — Sample 6A, 5/5
chunks.content: Q6 Continuity and Change scored 5/5 — describes a visual characteristic and uses specific evidence to explain the continuities and changes the work demonstrates, with clear significance. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q6 exemplar — Sample 6B, 3/5
chunks.content: Q6 scored 3/5 (A 1, B 1, C 1, D 0, E 0). Describes a visual characteristic and earns two explanation points, but the final two tasks fall short (evidence not specific or not tied to a continuity/change). Mid-range profile.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q6 exemplar — Sample 6C, 1/5
chunks.content: Q6 scored 1/5 (A 1, B–E 0). Earns only the visual-characteristic description; the explanation tasks are not completed with specific evidence tied to continuity or change. Description is the accessible floor; the explain tasks carry the rest of the points.
